name: Gyeoulsonyeo
source:
'Winter Girl' is a visual novel game that begins with a miraculous encounter with the alien, Seah. Combining modern direction with classic visual novel charm, it offers an immersive story and interactions. Experience various endings based on your choices. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2990650/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“Winter Girl”是一款视觉小说游戏，故事始于与外星人Seah的奇妙邂逅。将现代方向与经典视觉小说魅力相结合，提供身临其境的故事和互动。根据你的选择体验不同的结局。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2990650/]Steam[/url]]
